Description.content: My name is Cynthia and I live in Manta. There are three elementary schools and two high schools in Manta. My school is on Montecristi Street. We have a very nice building. There is a sports center next to my school. Every Wednesday afternoon, we play basketball. If you want to see a film, you can go to the only cinema we have. Unfortunately, there aren't any theaters here.

content.content: There are four elementary schools and three high schools.

Description.content: My name is Nam. I'm ten years old. I live in Ha Noi. I enjoy maths, music and art. My favorite food is chips. I don't like pork. In the afternoon, I usually play chess with my father. It's really fun.
Hi, I'm Mai. I’m tall and slim. I have brown hair and blue eyes. My favorite subject is PE and my favorite color is green.

Hello. My name is Bill. I'm ten years old. I'm in grade 5. I live in Thai Binh Province. I like maths, science and art. My favourite food is fish. I usually play football in the afternoon. It's really fun.

Hi, I'm Kathy and I live in Chicago. I live in a house near the library. My school is next to my house. I walk to school every day. I'm in 5th grade. My brother, Kevin is in 9th grade and his school is in the city centre, next to the library.

content.content: Kathy's school is next to her house.

Description.content: I'm Linh. I'm ten years old. I live in Ho Chi Minh City. I like geography, music and English. My favourite food is chicken. I don't like beef. In the evening, I usually play the piano with my sister. It's really fun.

content.content: English is one of Linh's favourite subjects.

Description.content: My name is Tom. My favourite food is fish and chips. I’m a fan of baseball.

My house is where my family lives. It is blue. There are four bedrooms. We have a kitchen and three bathrooms. Our family room is where we like to watch television together. When people come over, we eat in the dining room.We have a playroom in the basement. We have a swing in the backyard. I love my house.

content.content: There is a swing in the basement.

Description.content: My name is Linda. I live in a big city with my parents. I love drawing and playing the piano.
I live in Australia. I have one brother and three sisters. I like maths and PE more than English.

The coral reefs have been destroyed; the dolphin Hubert and his friends in the ocean have left. You are the diver whose mission is to recreate such reefs and bring marine creatures back.
Read each passage carefully and decide whether the given statement is true or false by choosing the relevant button. You have 20 minutes to answer all the questions. 
You will get points for each correct answer and deserved results with each score range you achieve.
Check your score and completion time at the end of the test.
The test is over when you submit all your answers or the time is up.
